m.e: Spar's daughter died of a drug overdose.

m.t: Ha tenido una sobredosis por tu jodido té de Jobi.
m.e: He's overdosing on your damn jobi tea.

m.e: We're still waiting on test results, But we suspect it's some type of od.

m.e: But OD'ing on Adderall was finally my way of controlling him.

m.t: Es como si les hubiesen lavado el cerebro.
m.e: It's like... like they've been brainwashed.

m.t: Si esas chicas hubiesen sido chicos, no estarían teniendo una educación, estarían muertos.
m.e: If those girls were boys, they wouldn't be getting education, they'd be dead.

m.t: La mayoría de los chicos habrían hecho lo que hubiesen querido.
m.e: Most guys would've just done what they wanted to do.

m.t: No me hubiesen invitado si no fuese por la regla.
m.e: They wouldn't invite me if it wasn't for the rule.

m.t: ¡No estaríamos en este problema si los Padres no hubiesen aparecido!
m.e: We wouldn't be in such trouble had the Padres not come!

m.t: Bueno, lo haría si hubiesen aceptado a la mujer que amo.
m.e: Well, I would've done if they'd accepted the woman I love.

m.t: Nada de esto hubiese pasado si me hubiesen dejado entrar allí.
m.e: None of this would've ever happened if they just left me in there.

m.t: Parecía que hubiesen estado matando gente por mucho tiempo.
m.e: It looked like they'd been killing people for a while.

m.t: Si hubieses sido cualquier otro, no te hubiesen suspendido.
m.e: If you had been anyone else, you wouldn't have been suspended.

m.t: Si las cosas hubiesen sido distintas, podríamos haber formado nuestra propia familia.
m.e: If things would have been different, we'd have had a family of our own by now.

m.t: Y escogió deliberadamente un lugar donde no hubiesen cámaras de seguridad.
m.e: And deliberately picked a spot where there'd be no security cameras.

m.t: Si hubiesen querido quitarnos esto lo habrían destruido, no protegido.
m.e: If they wanted to take this one from us forever, they would've destroyed it, not protected it.

m.t: Si se hubiesen movido, se habrían convertido en estatuas de oro.
m.e: Had they moved, they'd all be golden statues.

m.t: No habríamos estado ahí si ustedes gatitos no nos hubiesen pedido ayuda.
m.e: We wouldn't have even been there if you pussies hadn't called us for help.

m.t: Si lo hubiesen matado por los Derechos Civiles al menos hubiera muerto por algo.
m.e: If he'd been killed for civil rights, then at least it would have meant something.

m.t: Bueno, si fuese yo y me hubiesen robado 70.000 dólares, iría a la policía.
m.e: Well, if it were me and I had $70,000 stolen, I would go to the police.

m.t: Si te hubiesen condenado, el proceso de apelaciones hubiese sido un paseo.
m.e: If you'da been convicted, the appeal process would have been a fucking field day.

m.t: Todos rieron como si fuese lo más divertido que hubiesen escuchado nunca.
m.e: Everyone laughed like it was the funniest thing they had ever heard.

m.t: Como si tú y Linda hubiesen podido emprender algo.
m.e: Like you and Linda could just set up shop.

m.t: Aceptaría un cheque. ¿A menos que no hubiesen fondos?
m.e: He'd take a cheque. Unless there weren't the funds to honour it?

m.t: Pienso que ya lo hubiesen hecho.
m.e: I think you would have already done it.

m.t: Las cosas hubiesen sido realmente diferentes.
m.e: Things would've been really different.

m.t: Me hubiesen dicho algo.
m.e: They would tell me something.

m.t: Quizás si hubiesen tenido una madre como la mía, no serían los mierdas que son ahora.
m.e: Maybe if they had a mom like mine, They wouldn't be the pieces of shit that they are currently.

m.t: Y para el expediente, las cosas se hubiesen desarrollado de esta manera, sino fuese por esto.
m.e: And for the record, things would've unfolded that way exactly, but for this.

m.t: Tom y Mary no hubiesen hecho eso si John no se lo hubiese pedido.
m.e: Tom and Mary wouldn't have done that if John hadn't asked them to.

m.t: Es como si hubiesen estado ahí de pie, esperando a ser asesinados.
m.e: It's as if they were just standing there, waiting to be killed.

m.e: - It's like you really did get hit with a memo eraser.

m.t: Será como si nunca se hubiesen ido.
m.e: It will be as if you never left.

m.t: - Como si ni siquiera le hubiesen tocado.
m.e: - Like he wasn't even touched.

m.t: Con todo respeto, teniente pero me siento muy ofendido.
m.e: All due respect, Lieutenant, but I feel very disrespected right now.

m.t: He sido más ofendido por ti que por cualquier otra persona.
m.e: I have been more offended by you than anyone else.

m.t: Vale, voy a tratar de no sentirme ofendido por eso.
m.e: Okay, I'm gonna try not to be offended at that.

m.t: Si te sientes ofendido, consigue un ascenso.
m.e: If you feel wronged, get promoted.

m.t: Creo que estaba un poco ofendido.
m.e: I guess I was a little offended.

m.t: Y entiendo que estés ofendido conmigo.
m.e: And I understand why you resent me.
